description: This file defines the DeviceConfig class within the cuttlefish::modem namespace, providing static methods for device-specific hooks related to modem simulation, such as retrieving host IDs, file paths, and opening file streams.

classes.name: DeviceConfig
classes.description: A class providing static methods for device-specific configuration and file handling in the modem simulator context.

methods.name: host_id
methods.description: Returns the host ID for the device.

methods.name: PerInstancePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns a path specific to the device instance based on the provided filename.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for host artifacts given a filename.

methods.name: ril_address_and_prefix
methods.description: Retrieves the RIL address and prefix as a string.

methods.name: open_ifstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens a cross-platform input file stream for the given filename.

methods.name: open_ofstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens a cross-platform output file stream for the given filename with optional mode.
